title: Form Energy footer
description: A black footer in four columns: a large white wordmark over a two-line tagline, a spaced mono MENU heading over medium white links, a CONTACT column with a light address and two bold emails, and small square social buttons outlined in orange. A dark hairline divides it from a mono legal row split by thin orange rules, with the copyright at the right. Phones centre and stack everything. Links and icons turn orange on hover.
notes: a .dark scope: black under any theme
social icons come in as nodes (e.g. lucide icons); give each a label for screen readers
